tools.name: imkersalescrm_list_products
tools.description: List the products in the shop with price, VAT rate, active state, category and stock fields (in_stock, reserved, available). Filter by active state, category or name/SKU. Imker API: GET /api/v1/products.

tools.name: imkersalescrm_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by id, with its full description, stock fields and category ids. Imker API: GET /api/v1/products/:id.

tools.name: imkersalescrm_list_orders
tools.description: List orders with paging and filters: status id, internal status (placed, canceled, returned), payment status, date range, customer email, product id or SKU, and updated_since to fetch only changed orders. Use updated_since with the time of your last run to poll for changes. Imker API: GET /api/v1/or

tools.name: imkersalescrm_get_order
tools.description: Get one order with its items, addresses, costs, notes and attributes. The uuid field is an access secret for the order's cart; do not share it. Imker API: GET /api/v1/orders/:id.

tools.name: imkersalescrm_list_order_statuses
tools.description: List the visible order statuses with their ids. Use an id when you filter orders by status. Imker API: GET /api/v1/order_statuses.

tools.name: imkersalescrm_list_delivery_types
tools.description: List the delivery types with their ids. Use an id in discount codes that cover delivery. Imker API: GET /api/v1/delivery_types.

tools.name: imkersalescrm_list_discount_codes
tools.description: List discount codes with type, value, limits, usage count, validity dates and active state. Filter by type, active state or code/name. Imker API: GET /api/v1/discount_codes.

tools.name: imkersalescrm_get_discount_code
tools.description: Get one discount code by id with all its rules. Imker API: GET /api/v1/discount_codes/:id.

tools.name: imkersalescrm_create_discount_code
tools.description: Create a discount code that customers can use at checkout. It goes live at once unless start_date is in the future. Needs a key with the write_data scope. Imker API: POST /api/v1/discount_codes.

tools.name: imkersalescrm_update_discount_code
tools.description: Change a discount code. Send only the fields to change. Needs a key with the write_data scope. Imker API: PATCH /api/v1/discount_codes/:id.

tools.name: imkersalescrm_get_sales_report
tools.description: Get the number and sum of orders placed in a date range (canceled and returned orders are left out), optionally grouped by day, week or month. The range may span up to 1830 days. Imker API: GET /api/v1/reports/sales.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "imkersalescrm_get_order" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: imkersalescrm_list_orders · Private data: imkersalescrm_get_order · Public sink: imkersalescrm_list_orders, imkersalescrm_get_order, imkersalescrm_create_discount_code, imkersalescrm_update_discount_code · Destructive: imkersalescrm_list_orders.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: imkersalescrm_list_orders · Private data: imkersalescrm_get_order · Public sink: imkersalescrm_list_orders, imkersalescrm_get_order, imkersalescrm_create_discount_code, imkersalescrm_update_discount_code · Destructive: imkersalescrm_list_orders

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
